external_drive: Private core-E Poisson retained through moments; shared OU removed; surround and I external drive deterministic.

input_labels.sigma_ext_squared: External input variance (V_ext in source equations), not a time-dependent noise realization

shared_parameter: Displayed J_EE,core is the dimensionless multiplier g in model.py: W_AE,AE and W_BE,BE scale by g; corresponding Q scales by g^2.
edge_convention: Triangle: excitatory AMPA mean input; filled dot: inhibitory GABA mean input. Pathway weights, delays and variance coefficients are not encoded by line width. Crossings are not connections.
node_convention: Population variables; self-loops are within-population recurrence, not single-cell autapses.
scope: Historical six-population model structure; no claim of native-SNN correspondence or clinical mechanism.
